pk.context: 60 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: green and blue, opaque, delayed-release capsule

clues.kinetics: Well absorbed, and food does not affect peak concentration, though it marginally reduces the extent of absorption. More than 90% is bound to plasma proteins, and it is eliminated mainly by hepatic metabolism.
clues.substance: A hydrochloride salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 297.4. It is slightly soluble in water.
clues.product: An NDA product in 20, 30 and 60 mg delayed-release capsules.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for suicidal thoughts and behavior in children, adolescents and young adults. Contraindicated with MAOIs such as linezolid or intravenous methylene blue; nausea and dizziness are common.
clues.indication: Major depressive disorder and generalized anxiety disorder, plus diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia and chronic musculoskeletal pain.
clues.mechanism: It selectively inhibits serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake, potentiating serotonergic and noradrenergic activity in the CNS. Its exact mechanism in humans is unknown.

tell: Its capsules hold enteric-coated pellets designed to protect this SNRI from degradation.
